title: Contact Pressures

positions.as_written: Expect open chain extension near full extension to be the provocative manoeuvre in an irritable joint.
Counsel weight loss as a proportional reduction in force, which is a mechanical argument the patient can follow.
Absolute peak pressure figures are rig dependent and should not be carried between studies.
Expect a procedure that moves or enlarges contact to help more than one aimed at the force.
Stage rehabilitation by the arc and the chain rather than by a resistance figure.
Avoid citing a peak pressure from one cadaveric rig as a property of the joint.
State plainly that native in vivo pressure is not measurable, when the question is asked.
